definitions.explanation: The property of certain substances to emit radiation through the decay of atomic nuclei. Also used loosely in everyday language to refer to radiation or radioactive contamination in general.

examples.japanese: {放射能|ほうしゃのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{検出|けんしゅつ}→検出：13132_kenshutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{放射能|ほうしゃのう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Radioactivity testing of food products is being conducted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{放射能|ほうしゃのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{放出|ほうしゅつ}→放出：12926_houshutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A large amount of radioactivity was released into the environment due to the accident.

notes:
USAGE:
Strictly speaking, {放射能|ほうしゃのう} refers to the property of emitting radiation, while ⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧ refers to the radiation itself, and ⟦{放射性|ほうしゃせい}→放射性：28219_houshasei⟧⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧ refers to radioactive material. However, in everyday Japanese, {放射能|ほうしゃのう} is often used loosely to refer to any of these.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放射能|ほうしゃのう}⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧: radioactive contamination
- {放射能|ほうしゃのう}⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧: radiation leak
- {放射能|ほうしゃのう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: radioactivity testing
- {放射能|ほうしゃのう}⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧: radioactivity level

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧: radiation (the rays themselves)
- ⟦{放射性|ほうしゃせい}→放射性：28219_houshasei⟧: radioactive (as prefix/adjective)
